entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If this is really how people feel, there's[n]no way we'll be able to steal their hearts...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've come here for nothing...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: This is horrible...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: You imbeciles are intoxicated by an[n]undesired "justice"...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: This is the will of the children of man[n]who have fallen into sloth.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: My shine is proof that they desire my[n]existence.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: As long as humanity yearns for me, I shall[n]never perish...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is this really what everyone wants? To stop[n]thinking and be guided by the Holy Grail?
We can't accept that.
Don't let it fool you.
It's too bad...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes... It's so frustrating it makes me want[n]to cry...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I... I will never agree!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The humans I look up to aren't like that...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No matter how painful reality is, it's[n]all over if you don't try to change how[n]things are!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm not the only one who believes that.[n]Everyone here agrees...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We don't want to turn back into the[n]people we used to be! That's why we[n]risked our lives coming here!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mona-chan...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's right!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Humanity already wishes for their[n]distortions to be actualized.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: I am merely the being that will ultimately[n]grant those wishes.

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Now, it is time I refrain from my place in[n]this world, and begin to encroach upon[n]reality itself.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's a load of shit!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Encroach? What is it gonna do!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, this doesn't look good!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I've got a bad feeling about this...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Mona! What should we do!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I don't know what you are, but you can't[n]keep arbitrarily deciding all this on your[n]own.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Humans aren't all stupid like you say[n]they are!

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Hmph. Indolent, foolish humans.[n]You shall offer your hearts to me...

entries.speaker: Holy Grail
entries.en: Now, the time for the fusion has come...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hey, the ground's...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's vanishing!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell no...

entries.speaker: Unknown Voice
entries.en: Mor...gana...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh!? Who's that!?

entries.speaker: Unknown Voice
entries.en: You... are... my...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: N-No way...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I see... So that's how it was...[n]I remember everything now...

entries.speaker: Unknown Voice
entries.en: Mor...gana...

entries.speaker: Unknown Voice
entries.en: You... are... our...
